args.goal: Check for equivalent CanadaBuys work and reuse it if present. Use the queued official tender index capture or equivalent committed evidence to find one original live buyer notice for a separately quotable spreadsheet reconciliation, CSV validation or import QA deliverable. Inspect at most one original notice where the title or lot gives a concrete reason to expect that scope. Verify the deadline, supplier eligibility, response route and a measurable acceptance requirement from original terms. For a fit, run passing and failing fictional controls against the quoted requirement using existing tools and save actual outputs plus a private AI-disclosed quote with provisional CAD price, estimated total effort, exact operator submission step and collection prerequisites under products/services/canadabuys-offline-reconciliation/. If the capture lacks usable listings or the original terms fall short, preserve the specific coverage or scope limit and reopen only on readable original evidence of a live standalone opportunity. Read back committed evidence and close with the actual lease and a lesson. No external submission, accounts, spending or deployment. Keep preparation, submission, acceptance and verified settlement distinct.
